errors.evidence: The blue data series is represented as an area chart, not a line chart. The description incorrectly identifies it as a line.
There are no markers on the blue data series (the area chart). The data points are labeled with their numerical values, but there are no square symbols on the plot itself.
The orange line does not have any markers. The percentages are text labels. Furthermore, the legend indicates the marker type is a square, not a circle.
The 28% growth value is positioned above the year 2018, not 2017. It represents the growth from 2017 to 2018.
The peak percentage growth shown on the chart is 28% (in 2018), not 26%.
